title: From Data Room to Report: End-to-End AI Support for M&A Legal Due Diligence
abstract: arXiv:2611.34120v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Legal due diligence in mergers and acquisitions requires lawyers to organize heterogeneous virtual data room documents, extract transaction-relevant information and consolidate reviewed findings into a due diligence report. We present LEXI (Legal Extraction and Intelligence), a work-in-progress system that demonstrates how large language models can support this process from document ingestion to report preparation. LEXI classifies documents under a configurable due diligence taxonomy, assigns relevant target entities, extracts predefined information with supporting passages and page-level provenance and prepares report content from reviewed findings. Structured outputs connect these stages and allow model-generated results to be passed through the workflow in a controlled form. Lawyers review and correct classifications and extractions and retain responsibility for legal assessments, recommendations, risk ratings and final report wording

translated_title: 从资料室到报告：面向并购法律尽职调查的端到端AI支持
translated_abstract: 并购中的法律尽职调查要求律师整理异构的虚拟资料室文档，提取与交易相关的信息，并将审核后的发现整合为尽职调查报告。我们提出了LEXI（Legal Extraction and Intelligence，法律提取与智能系统），这是一个进行中的系统，展示了大语言模型如何支持从文档接入到报告编制的全过程。LEXI在可配置的尽职调查分类体系下对文档进行分类，分配相关目标实体，提取带有支持性段落和页级来源溯源的预定义信息，并根据审核后的发现编制报告内容。结构化输出连接了各个阶段，使模型生成的结果能够以受控的形式在工作流中传递。律师负责审核和纠正分类与提取结果，并保留对法律评估、建议、风险评级和最终报告措辞的最终责任。
tldr: LEXI是一个利用大语言模型支持并购法律尽职调查全流程的端到端AI系统，在律师人工审核的控制下完成文档分类、信息提取与报告编制。
en_tdlr: LEXI is an end-to-end AI system that uses large language models to support the full M&A legal due diligence workflow—from document classification and information extraction with provenance to report preparation—while lawyers retain review and final responsibility.
